npc_finding: No clear book-bubble NPC-centered false detection observed in these 15 validation frames at confidence 0.25. Neighboring real mob boxes can overlap NPC pixels; this is a limited visual audit, not proof of general NPC discrimination.
special_finding: Four neighboring late sample1 attack frames miss the special under damage text, spell effects, and sprite overlap. Dialogue frame 0000 correctly has no special prediction.
hero_finding: All 15 reviewed heroes match at IoU 0.50. Frame 0013 has an additional shifted/oversized hero box over the monitor/effect cluster. Some jump/occluded boxes are tighter than the full reviewed preset extent.
mob_finding: Seven unmatched predictions and three misses against reviewed labels, primarily crowded overlapping instances; frame 0012 also has a mob prediction over the hero/effect area.
conclusion: First APO development checkpoint is trained and recoverable. Main observed weakness is special recall under attack effects. No automatic deployment; broader independent video testing remains future work.
